needs.proposedSignature: Conditions { kind: 'poison-ge'; who: 'you' | 'opponent' | 'any'; value: number }, { kind: 'x-ge'; value: number }, { kind: 'first-combat-phase' }; effect `sacrifice` gains amount: number | 'all'; Filter gains { extreme: 'greatest-power' | 'least-power'; among: ObjectSet }.
needs.semantics: Four independent holes this batch hit: 'As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters' (Skrelv's Hive), 'If X is 5 or more' (White Sun's Twilight), 'If it's the first combat phase of your turn' (Tifa), and 'sacrifice all creatures you control' / 'a creature with the greatest power among creatures they control' (Emrakul, Shadowgrange Archfiend).
needs.clause: As long as an opponent has three or more poison counters, creatures you control with toxic have lifelink.

needs.proposedSignature: AltCost.id gains 'madness' ({ id: 'madness', label: 'madness', cost, from: 'exile' }) plus a discard replacement static { kind: 'discard-replacement', instead: 'exile-then-may-cast' } that exiles the discarded card and creates a reflexive trigger to cast it for its madness cost.
needs.semantics: If a player would discard this card, they discard it into exile instead. When they do, they may cast it for its madness cost; if they don't, it goes to the graveyard.
